name: Steel & Metals Cross-Sectional Momentum (Long-Only)
description: Long-only cross-sectional momentum strategy on 10 steel and metals stocks (NUE, STLD, X, CLF, AA, ATI, CENX, FCX, SCCO, RS). Signal: 6-month (126-day) momentum skipping the most recent 1 month (21 days) to avoid short-term reversal. Long top 3 by momentum rank, flat on everything else. Equal weight within the long portfolio (1/3 per position). Monthly rebalance on first trading day.
source:
# Steel & Metals Cross-Sectional Momentum (Long-Only)
# Source: Jegadeesh & Titman (1993) with skip-month refinement
#
# RULES:
# - Universe: 10 steel & metals stocks (NUE, STLD, X, CLF, AA, ATI, CENX, FCX, SCCO, RS)
# - Signal: 6-month momentum (126 days) skipping most recent 1 month (21 days)
#   to avoid short-term reversal effect
# - Selection: Long top 3 by momentum, flat on everything else (no shorts)
# - Weighting: Equal weight within long portfolio (1/3 each)
# - Rebalancing: Monthly (first trading day)

# Data source - DAILY
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# 6-month momentum, skipping most recent 21 days
# Return from t-126 to t-21: (price 21 days ago) / (price 126 days ago) - 1
momentum_6m_skip = (close >> 21) / (close >> 126) - 1

# Cross-sectional selection: top 3 by momentum (long), flat on everything else
is_top_3 = cs_select(direction=CSSelectDirection.top, mode=CSSelectMode.count, k=3)(momentum_6m_skip)

# Detect first trading day of month
is_new_month = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.month)(index())

# Monthly rebalance signals for LONG positions
enter_long = is_new_month and is_top_3
exit_long = is_new_month and not is_top_3
held_long = hold_until()(enter=enter_long, exit=exit_long)

# Long-only execution: exit_long as short_entry closes long zone (goes flat, not short)
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held_long, short_entry=exit_long)

# Equal weight across long positions only (top 3 = ~33% each)
weights = equal_weight()(held_long)

# Position sizing - ONLY rebalance on first trading day of month
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=weights * 100, rebalance_on=is_new_month)
